checks.name: environment_smoke
checks.cases: Correct sequential fixture passed, deliberately wrong fixture failed, repaired fixture passed.

checks.name: initial
checks.coverage: All 19 original waveform rows at timestamps 0 through 90 ns, covering all 16 binary input combinations.

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation is performed externally after submission.
The original waveform specifies binary input behavior only; no additional unknown-input behavior was assumed.
justified_rtl_changes: Initial implementation assigns q = b | c, matching every original waveform row; a and d are irrelevant to the binary truth table. No RTL revisions were needed.
justified_tb_changes: Initial testbench uses a waveform-derived expected-output table, exact original timestamps with delta-cycle settling, fatal mismatch checks, and a bounded timeout. No testbench revisions were needed.
